language_detection.name: language_detection
language_detection.note: ElevenLabs system tool. The application does not implement this as its own speech-engine switch.

tools.name: save_customer_details
tools.description: Save name, callback number, email, address, issue, and preferred language on the current inquiry.

tools.name: lookup_service_info
tools.description: Read one service from the price book, including assumptions and exclusions.

tools.name: calculate_estimate
tools.description: Calculate an estimate from the price book. Inspection-only work has no firm total.

tools.name: send_continuation_link
tools.description: Email a secure continuation link. Does not end the call.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Recheck the slot and create the appointment. Success means the calendar accepted it.

tools.name: request_human_followup
tools.description: Ask Alex Rivera to follow up. Does not dispatch a technician.
